This topic is part of the AQA A-Level German specification.

Multiculturalism in German-speaking Society appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Multiculturalism in German-speaking Society in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Multiculturalism in German-speaking Society.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
